title: Amelia | Striped patchwork shirt with collar, coastal ease
bodyHtml:
This shirt captures the relaxed charm of seaside living with a striped patchwork design that's anything but ordinary. The clever mix of blue and white goes beyond your classic nautical stripe, creating a dynamic and thoughtfully layered look that calls to mind ocean tones and breezy afternoons. A structured collar adds polish without pretence, while the relaxed, generous fit lets you move freely from morning coffee to evening plans—no fussing required.

Why you'll love it

  • Patchwork striping in blue and white that feels contemporary and distinctly you—nothing predictable here
  • Structured collar that brings subtle femininity and effortless sophistication to any casual moment
  • Relaxed, generous fit that skims without clinging, giving you total freedom and all-day comfort
  • Fresh blue and white palette that pairs beautifully with white trousers, light denim, or neutral everything
  • Light and breathable—crisp on the skin, perfect for warm days and cooler evenings alike
  • Works everywhere: lunch at Circular Quay, weekend brunch, casual seaside stroll, evening drinks—always refined
  • Genuinely hard to find in this contemporary patchwork style—it elevates classic stripes with real character
